verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a purpose-built AI agent in its platform. Users tell Neo what they need in plain English, and it handles dependencies, executes changes and monitors outcomes. Tasks can also be delegated to Neo from external assistants via the official MCP server. The evidence is vendor marketing and docs only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how delegation works inside Pulumi Cloud (UI, approval flow, scope of task types), and independent or hands-on corroboration that Neo delivers as claimed.
